source: correct Claims typography and build claim details with timeline sheet

assumptions.text: typography: Claims metric labels and suffixes use text-sm 14px while primary metric values use text-2xl 24px
Every Recent Claims action navigates to a dynamic claim-number route and the selected row number becomes the detail-page heading
Employee, treatment, status, document, and timeline details use the representative values shown in Figma while only the claim number varies by route
The designer selected the detailed current-status Card with Compass Progress at 75 percent and the 2024-01-20 due date
View timeline opens a Compass Sheet using SheetHeader, SheetTitle, ScrollArea, Item, and Separator
The 630px Figma timeline panel maps to the nearest Compass container token, max-w-2xl at 672px; mobile retains the Sheet default three-quarter width
The black Figma timeline CTA maps to the Compass default primary Button instead of introducing an unsupported dark variant
typography: The 32px Figma claim identifier maps to text-3xl 30px on desktop and the responsive text-2xl 24px mobile tier
Status and Claims breadcrumb links both return to the Claims list because no separate Status route exists
asset: The existing Figma-derived claims metric illustration is reused at 56px and matching Lucide icons use Compass-controlled sizes
